Some deficiencies here and there, but not bad. I enjoyed the process. Updated for the 4th time so far, with a bit more higher resolution videos. They take awhile, so not sure if I will do next time.

Added some longer periods of specific characters: Mita from Miside and Miku. Hopefully this helps rather than jumping around from character to character.

If you have suggestions, let me know, thanks.
